# lazymatrix

`lazymatrix` provides a framework for working with transformed sparse
data matrices using [lazy
evaluation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lazy_evaluation). This
approach is particularly useful for handling large sparse matrices where
transformations (e.g., centering and scaling) would otherwise result in
dense matrices, consuming significant memory and computational
resources.

## Installation

You can install the development version of lazymatrix from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("vsegersall/lazymatrix")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(lazymatrix)
set.seed(123)
sparse_matrix <- Matrix::Matrix(0, 5, 3)
sparse_matrix[sample(length(sparse_matrix), 5)] <- rnorm(5)
b <- rnorm(3)
lazy_matrix <- LazyMatrix(sparse_matrix, scale = "sd", location = "mean")
print(lazy_matrix)
#> An object of class "LazyMatrix"
#> Slot "data":
#> 5 x 3 sparse Matrix of class "dgCMatrix"
#>                                      
#> [1,]  .         1.55870831  .        
#> [2,]  .         .           .        
#> [3,]  .         .           .        
#> [4,] -0.5604756 0.07050839 -0.2301775
#> [5,]  .         0.12928774  .        
#> 
#> Slot "col_scales":
#> [1] 0.2506523 0.6769030 0.1029385
#> 
#> Slot "row_scales":
#> [1] 0.89992066 0.00000000 0.00000000 0.31560781 0.07464431
#> 
#> Slot "col_locations":
#> [1] -0.1120951  0.3517009 -0.0460355
#> 
#> Slot "row_locations":
#> [1]  0.51956944  0.00000000  0.00000000 -0.24004825  0.04309591
lazy_matrix %*% b
#> 5 x 1 Matrix of class "dgeMatrix"
#>           [,1]
#> [1,] -1.751397
#> [2,]  2.225999
#> [3,]  2.225999
#> [4,] -4.596694
#> [5,]  1.896092
```

## Contribution

As this is part of a university project and the fact that the project
does not have a stable version yet, the project is closed for
contributions. We are however happy to discuss ideas for the future so
feel free to contact the authors or make an issue for functionalities
you would like to see within `lazymatrix`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`LazyMatrix-class`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/LazyMatrix-class.md)
  : LazyMatrix S4 class
- [`LazyMatrix()`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/LazyMatrix.md)
  : Constructs a LazyMatrix object.
- [`as.matrix(`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/as.matrix-LazyMatrix-method.md)
  : Attempts to turn the data matrix to a scaled matrix-object.
- [`colnames(`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/colnames-LazyMatrix-method.md)
  : Retrieve or set the row or column names of a LazyMatrix object.
- [`crossprod(`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`,`*`<ANY>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/crossprod-LazyMatrix-ANY-method.md)
  : Crossproduct for LazyMatrix
- [`dim(`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/dim-LazyMatrix-method.md)
  : Returns the dimension of a LazyMarix Object.
- [`` `%*%`( ``*`<ANY>`*`,`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/grapes-times-grapes-ANY-LazyMatrix-method.md)
  : Matrix multiplication for vector and LazyMatrix
- [`` `%*%`( ``*`<LazyMatrix>`*`,`*`<ANY>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/grapes-times-grapes-LazyMatrix-ANY-method.md)
  : Matrix multiplication for LazyMatrix and vector
- [`` `%*%`( ``*`<LazyMatrix>`*`,`*`<matrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/grapes-times-grapes-LazyMatrix-matrix-method.md)
  : Matrix multiplication for LazyMatrix and matrix-object.
- [`lazy_crossprod_vec()`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/lazy_crossprod_vec.md)
  : Fast crossprod for LazyMatrix (dense case)
- [`lazy_crossprod_vec_sp()`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/lazy_crossprod_vec_sp.md)
  : Fast crossprod for LazyMatrix (sparse case)
- [`lsqr()`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/lsqr.md)
  : Performs least squares estimation on LazyMatrix object using the
  iterative lsqr algorithm.
- [`ncol(`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/ncol-LazyMatrix-method.md)
  : Returns the number of columns of the data matrix
- [`norm()`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/norm.md)
  : Computes the Frobenius norm of a LazyMatrix object.
- [`nrow(`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/nrow-LazyMatrix-method.md)
  : Returns the number of rows of the data matrix
- [`prcomp(`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/prcomp-LazyMatrix-method.md)
  : Performs a principal component analysis on the LazyMatrix object
  using irlba:s sparse svd.
- [`svd(`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/svd-LazyMatrix-method.md)
  : Singular Value decomposition for LazyMatrix.
- [`t(`*`<LazyMatrix>`*`)`](https://vsegersall.github.io/lazymatrix/reference/t-LazyMatrix-method.md)
  : Given a LazyMatrix x, t returns the transpose of x.
